# Source Control, Environments, Change and Deployment (DEP)

## SCS-DEP-01 Protect source code with Git branch protection

Level: MUST

Applies to: All (Flutter and Backend)

Policy: All source code MUST be kept in Git. Work is done on feature branches, and the main and release branches MUST be protected so that changes merge only through a merge request. No code is deployed to production without the Security Reviewer's final approval (SCS-TEST-04).

Implementation (all stacks):

- Restrict repository access to the team; use personal accounts with MFA, never shared Git accounts.
- Signed commits are recommended.

## SCS-DEP-02 Follow formal change management, including for emergencies

Level: MUST

Applies to: All (Flutter and Backend)

Policy: All application changes MUST follow the formal change management process: documented as a change record in Service Desk Plus linked to its merge request, with an impact assessment, regression testing, and a security evaluation and approval by the Security Reviewer (SCS-TEST-03, SCS-TEST-04). Patches MUST be tested in a staging environment before production. Emergency changes MUST be reviewed and documented after the fact.

Implementation (all stacks):

- Each change has a change record linked to its merge request, with impact assessment, test evidence and a link to the Security Review Report in the repository.
- Emergency fixes: deploy with Section Head approval and, where possible, the Security Reviewer's approval; otherwise complete the security review, documentation and any missing tests within 2 working days.

Verification: Each production deployment has a matching change record with Section Head approval, test evidence and the Security Reviewer's approval.

## SCS-DEP-03 Validate security configuration before every production release

Level: MUST

Applies to: All (Flutter and Backend)

Policy: Security configuration MUST be checked against a pre-deployment checklist before each production release. Production MUST NOT expose debug mode, test accounts, development endpoints, sample pages, API documentation, unnecessary services or open ports.

Implementation (all stacks):

- Checklist items include: release/production build; debug off; no test accounts or seed users; secrets from secure configuration; HTTPS/TLS settings; logging on; CORS and headers correct.

Implementation (.NET / SQL Server):

- ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production; developer exception page, Swagger/OpenAPI UI and detailed errors off; Hangfire or admin dashboards protected.
- Only required ports and IIS features enabled; default IIS pages removed.

Verification: The developer completes the checklist, the Security Reviewer confirms it as part of the evaluation (SCS-TEST-03), and it is attached to the release change record.
